description: Fastrack Ryz smartwatch featuring a 1.72” SUPER ULTRATM display with 2.5D graphics and a dynamic 60Hz refresh rate for smooth visuals and an immersive viewing experience. Designed with a premium alloy bezel, durable plastic case, and cross-grid pattern silicon strap, it offers both comfort and durability, while the functional crown ensures easy navigation through the FT Smart View One Navigation UI and multiple quick-change menu styles. Stay connected with Bluetooth calling and AI voice assistance, and keep track of your wellness with the 24/7 Health Suite, including Heart Rate Monitoring (HRM), SpO2 tracking, and sleep monitoring. The smartwatch also includes everyday smart utilities like a calculator, calendar, alarm, stopwatch, timer, and weather updates with smart nudges, while 1ATM water resistance adds reliability for daily use. With NitrofastTM Type-C charging, you can power up quickly and stay ready for your day without interruptions.
